title: Billing and Coding: B-Type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP)

codes.1: Note : Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
